item.title: TermiX Launches Walcert to Give Agents On-Chain Wallet Reputation Checks
item.summary: TermiX has integrated Walcert, a third-party wallet certification tool, into its Agent.family marketplace, giving autonomous AI agents on-demand, ERC-8004-signed reputation grades for any EVM wallet before executing transactions — with no human intermediation required. TermiX's X profile bio states the project is backed by YZi Labs (self-reported).
